_readme: The dated venue fee schedule used ONLY when a market does not report its
own fee_rate. A venue-reported rate always wins; this file exists so a
missing field is a known, dated assumption instead of a refusal that
Polymarket weather taker fee moves 0.05 -> 0.01 at 2026-11-20T23:59Z.
Entries are evaluated in order and the last entry whose effective_from_utc
is at or before the decision instant wins. The first entry has no lower
bound and therefore covers every earlier instant.
Changing a value here is a versioned change: bump `version`, update
docs/shadow-risk-rules.md, and say why. A fallback fee is never fitted to

entries.basis: Polymarket published weather taker rate before the 2026-11-20 change
Polymarket published weather taker rate from 2026-11-20T23:59Z
